description: The skills of declarations.json as the package admits them (ADR-0009, skill.json): each declaration with its digest, the digest of its bundle, which is the pinned one. Written by hand; skills.test.ts holds declareSkills to each digest.

items.name: expense_policy
items.description:
Apply the expense policy when drafting a reimbursement pack.
Covers mileage, meals and lodging.
items.instructions: Check each expense line against the policy: mileage at the rate rates__lookup_rate gives, meals within the daily cap, lodging only with a receipt. Name the line and the rule it breaks.

resources.name: caps
resources.text: Meals: 60 EUR a day. Lodging: a receipt is required.

items.name: issue_style
items.description: Write tracker issues in the team's style.
items.instructions: An issue's title is one line in the imperative. Its body says what was expected, what happened, and how to see it.

items.name: review_checklist
items.description: The tracker's review checklist, served as a prompt.
items.instructions: Before proposing a change, list what it touches and how it was tested.
